messages:
marta: FYI reproducible failure in quant eval harness on CI — shard run leaking batches after KV cache flush, causing long tail latency and a couple quality regressions. @jin @sam

eval-bot: CI failed: eval-harness/quant-job #2145 - shard 3 OOM :warning:

jin: Can you paste the failing log lines? which model & quant config?

marta: repro command (works locally):
```
docker run --rm redwood/eval-harness:latest \
  ./eval_runner --model redwood-small-q4_0 --shards 8 --shard 3 --seed 42 --quantize
```
log snippet:
```
[2026-11-22T03:12:41Z] BatchQueue: pushed 512 items, backlog=512
[2026-11-22T03:12:42Z] Worker-3: KVCache flush start seq=1023
[2026-11-22T03:12:42Z] Worker-4: dispatched batch id=0x7f8, seq=1023
[2026-11-22T03:12:42Z] Worker-3: KVCache flush complete seq=1022  <-- seq mismatch
[2026-11-22T03:12:42Z] Dispatcher: spilled 120 tasks to retry queue, backlog=632
[2026-11-22T03:12:43Z] Worker-3: OOM while allocating kvcache shard
```

sam: That seq mismatch looks like the race that lets in-flight requests see stale KV state. We hit something similar during model onboarding last month. Increasing heartbeat helped but didn't fully fix.

natalie: Also saw dashboard oddness: eval_shard_failure metric up but CI report shows low failure_rate. I think retries are being counted inconsistently — new retry_count label isn't in the failure_rate query. Putting a pin on that. :thinking_face: https://dashboards.redwood/incidents/eval-slos

ops-bot: Trace captured: https://tracing.redwood-internal/trace/0xabc123 (shows KV flush + dispatch overlap)

jin: Thanks. Please open an issue with the steps + attach logs. I'm going to try a small patch: add a barrier before KV flush and expose a kv_flush_in_progress gauge + dispatch_paused label so we can see behavior in metrics.

marta: Issue opened: https://rb.redwood/issue/6291 — repro steps + logs attached. Quick repro above also works on my laptop with 4 shards.

sam: I'll deploy a canary with the barrier + bump heartbeat 5s->30s on dev cluster and run the quant suite. If stable, I'll promote to canary-2 for full quant runs.

natalie: For dashboards I'll update queries to sum by retry_count and exclude retried events when computing failure_rate. I'll add a kv_flush_in_progress panel so SRE can correlate.

jin: Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/1187 — implements barrier, adds gauge, and a unit test that simulates concurrent flush/dispatch. Need an extra pair of eyes on perf impact.

marta: :thumbsup: running full quant benchmark overnight against the canary and will post results in the morning.

eval-bot: Canary deployment completed: eval-harness:v2.1.8-canary-3 - started at 1823456840

marta: Quick update: overnight run shows tail token latency ~25% lower and no regressions on rouge/bertscore for redwood-small-q4_0. Running the 100k eval sweep now to be sure.

jin: Nice. If metrics hold, schedule 2.1.8 release and backport to 2.1.x.
